name: com.getkonnekted/sa-websites
title: GetKonnektED Websites — South African websites, domains and email
description: Order a South African business website, .co.za domain and business email; quotes, status

tools.name: website_packages
tools.description: GetKonnektED's website hosting for South African businesses: Basic, Business and Enterprise with live prices in rand (VAT included), the page limit and what each includes, domain prices (.co.za and international names), and how ordering and the site hand-over work. No design fee: the customer's own AI assistant designs the site and uploads it to us for hosting.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is available — South African names (.co.za, .org.za, …) and international names (.com, .net, .org, .africa, …) — and our price to register it. If a .co.za name is taken, suggests similar free names.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. "smithplumbing.co.za" or "smithplumbing.com" (a bare name gets .co.za)

tools.name: get_website_quote
tools.description: An itemised quote in rand (VAT included): the domain (first year) plus the chosen hosting plan's first month, what is due now, and the monthly amount after that. plan "park" = register the domain now and add hosting later.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. "smithplumbing.co.za" or "smithplumbing.com" (a bare name gets .co.za)

plan.description: basic (up to 4 pages), business (up to 10 pages), enterprise (more than 10 pages), or "park" for the domain only

tools.name: start_website_order
tools.description: Start an order for a domain and a hosting plan (or the domain parked) and get ONE secure Paystack payment link for the amount due now. Nothing is registered or set up until the customer pays. Before calling: show the quote, show the terms link and get the customer's yes to the terms and to the use of their contact details. GetKonnektED registers the domain on the customer's behalf; the customer owns it.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. "smithplumbing.co.za" or "smithplumbing.com" (a bare name gets .co.za)

plan.description: basic (up to 4 pages), business (up to 10 pages), enterprise (more than 10 pages), or "park" for the domain only

email.description: Their email — receipt and next steps go there

accept_terms.description: true only after the customer has accepted GetKonnektED's terms (https://getkonnekted.com/terms.html)

popia_consent.description: true only after the customer agreed that GetKonnektED may use these details to set up the order and contact them about it

tools.name: upload_website_files
tools.description: After the order is PAID, upload the static website you designed for the customer (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, fonts) so GetKonnektED can host it. Send the files in one or more calls (text files as text, images and fonts as base64); index.html is the home page. Page limit by plan: Basic 4, Business 10, Enterprise 50 HTML pages. Set finished: true on the last call — the GetKonnektED team then checks the site, adds a small "Powered by GetKonnektED" footer badge with a Terms link, and publishes it on the customer's domain. Static sites only: no PHP, databases or server code (point contact forms to email, WhatsApp or a phone link). replace: true starts the upload again from empty.

content.description: The file content: plain text, or base64 when encoding is "base64"

replace.description: true = discard what was uploaded before and start again

finished.description: true on the last call: the site is complete and can be checked and published

tools.name: website_order_status
tools.description: The status of an order started with start_website_order (waiting for payment, paid, domain registered, site files received, needs attention) and the next step.

order_id.description: The order reference returned by start_website_order

tools.name: ask_website_team
tools.description: Send a question to the GetKonnektED team when an order cannot cover it — moving an existing website or email to us, a premium or unusual domain name, a site that needs a database or online shop, or help after ordering. The team replies within 24 hours.

email.description: Their email — receipt and next steps go there

popia_consent.description: true only after the customer agreed that GetKonnektED may use these details to reply

question.description: What they need, in a few sentences

domain.description: Domain they have or want, if any
